# OpenIE Avalanche — Educational Reference (https://avalanche.openie.dev)

> An open educational guide to evolutionary and computational ratchets, the 9-Rung Computer Intelligence Avalanche, Proposition 1's Compilation Threshold, thermodynamic forcing functions, and falsifiable scientific forecasting. Zero product marketing; all claims carry explicit evidence classes and disproof criteria.

## Core Scientific & Educational Concepts

- **What a Ratchet Is (`C = T ∘ G_θ ∘ E`)**: Across `3.8` billion years of biology (`CL01–CL24`) and `76` years of AI history (`AI01–AI38`), collective capability scales when participants **Externalize** structured state (`E`), **Ingest** strictly across cooperative activation thresholds and verification gates (`G_θ`, `V_j = 1`), and **Transform** state into non-regressing shared memory (`T`, `Q(t+1) >= Q(t)`).
- **Coherence per Joule (`CpJ`)**: `CpJ = Q / (E_compute + E_comm + E_idle)` [verified coherence units / J].
- **The 9-Rung Computer Intelligence Avalanche**:
  - *Phase 1 — Stateless Ephemeral Inference (`ΔT ≈ 1 <= ΔT*`)*: `R1 Search`, `R2 Generation`, `R3 Reasoning`, `R4 Communication`, `R5 Tool Use`.
  - *The Compilation Threshold (Proposition 1)*: `ΔT > ΔT* = E_compile / (p_0'(c_wake - c_0))` paired with a sound verification gate `C(z) = 1` (`CTA-T3..T6`, `CTA-T41..T45`).
  - *Phase 2 — Stateful Compiled Substrates (`ΔT > ΔT*`)*: `R6 Immersion`, `R7 Competence`, `R8 Ecology`, `R9 Economy`.
- **Strict Telemetry Grammar**: Physical DC shunt measurements (`measured_j`: Texas Instruments `INA238` `VIN` and `INA3221` `VDD_CPU_SOC_MSS` on `NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor`, `board_metered = true`), OS/on-chip hardware counters (`reported_j`: `RAPL`, Darwin `IOReport` / `ri_energy_nj`, `NVML`), and analytical circuit switching models (`est_j`: `Verilator VCD` + `AMD DS925`) are kept strictly separate and never summed.

## Open Experimental & Formal Evidence Summary

- **103 Six-Kernel `Lean 4.36.0` Theorems**: `45` in `communication-avalanche` (`CTA-T1..T45`), `27` in `lut-adapt`, and `31` in `time-as-an-index`, plus `5,393` `RCE` theorem constants (`1,264` declarations at `f87d6af2`) — checked inside `bubblewrap` (`bwrap`) by `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `leanchecker --paranoid`, and `Lean v4.36.0` (`0` `sorry`, `0` `opaque`, `0` `ofReduceBool`).
- **Ten-Paradigm Digital Enzymatic Synthesis (`DES-10`, `CTA-E5`)**: Across a pre-registered `100`-task five-regime benchmark where every isolated paradigm (`C1..C10`) scores `<= 49%` (`48%` solo LLM, `49%` 3-agent debate), coupling all 10 paradigms across attested binary `Phi_IR` channels reaches `98 / 100` (`98.0%`) at `9.26×–26.87×` higher physical Tegra `INA3221` `measured_j` `CpJ` (`75,374×` lower inter-organ handoff `measured_j` and `78,855×` lower latency than natural-language prose handoffs).
- **Downward Compilation Benchmarks**: `0.00%` broken commits admitted across `CTA-E2` (`59/60`), 48-task MoL study (`91.67%`), `BigCodeBench v0.1.3` (`90.62%`), and `40/40` `H15-Iterative` -> `1.77 µJ` `DNULLMM1` Gear-0 replay; `15.59 est_mW` clock-enable-gated idle dynamic power on a `4`-stage `250 MHz` `512×512` Beneš + `81 × RAMB36E2` `LUT6` RTL design.
